name: To Heart Hii Sunohara After
original_name: To Heart ひいっ 春原アフター
source:
Useless though I am, I have a wish.
Useless though I am, I have a precious memory.

A heartful comedy full of memories. 

[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE031621.html]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
虽然我一无是处，但我有一个愿望。
虽然我一无是处，但我有一段珍贵的回忆。

一部充满回忆的温馨喜剧。

[引自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE031621.html]DLsite[/url]]
